name: Skill Seekers
description: Transform 17 source types into AI-ready skills and RAG knowledge. Ingest documentation sites, GitHub repos, PDFs, Jupyter notebooks, videos, Word docs, EPUBs, OpenAPI specs, Confluence, Notion, Slack/Discord exports, and more. Package for 16+ LLM platforms. Includes 35 MCP tools, 3 slash commands, and an auto-invoked skill-builder agent.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, **3 commands** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (1): `skill-builder` (Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers)
- **Commands** (3): `create-skill` (Create an AI skill from any source (URL, repo, PDF, video, notebook, etc.)), `install-skill` (One-command skill creation and packaging for a target platform), `sync-config` (Sync a scraping config's URLs against the live documentation site)
- **MCP servers** (1): `skill-seekers`

Installs with `claude plugin install skill-seekers@claude-community` from `yusufkaraaslan/skill-seekers-plugin`.
